summary: 013 SC-005 (defensible, v4): bare HoeDirt + mulch expires on 7th spring day-start tick (TickMulch decrements then removes at <=0 before decay check) → unprotected spring decay applies once (DailyDecayRate*0.5=1), soil 50->49 (0.98). cropPhaseDelta not-applicable.

initCommands.description: till bare HoeDirt target (no crop; decay path applies)
seed measured moderate soil (spring decay 2*0.5=1/day when unprotected)
apply mulch on bare tilled tile (MulchDurationDays=7)

thresholds.description: 7 day-start ticks: mulch protects ticks 1-6 (7->1), tick 7 removes before decay so one unprotected spring decay applies (50-1=49, factor 0.98)

signalPolicy.not-applicableReason: Bare HoeDirt no-crop decay-path target at 61,15; SoilDecayService applies decay only when crop==null, so crop phase is not attestable for this observed tile.
